title: Bharat International Rice Conference to Be Held in October

blocks.content: The Bharat International Rice Conference (BIRC) 2026 is the second edition of the event and will be held from 23 to 25 October 2026 at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi. The Indian Rice Exporters’ Federation (IREF), which represents over 8,000 rice exporters, is organising the conference.

items: The inaugural BIRC 2025 was held on 30 and 31 October 2025 at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.
BIRC 2025 attracted 10,854 visitors, including 1,083 international buyers from over 90 countries.
BIRC 2025 facilitated trade commitments worth ₹33,453 crore, or about USD 3.02 billion.
Those trade commitments covered about 8.63 million metric tonnes of rice.
